'''Fennesa''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]], rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Its fauna included [[Unidentified avian species (Fennesa)|avian]] and [[Unidentified feline species (Fennesa)|feline]] [[Diet/Legends|predators]] as well as [[mountain nerf]]s, a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[ungulate]] [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] introduced by [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

The nerfs on Fennesa were kept by local [[Nerf herder/Legends|herders]]. The latter were a tough people who, as a part of their profession, had to deal with predation, the nerfs' own rambunctious nature, and the eventual loss of the sense of smell due to the herd creatures' foul odor. At some point, an [[Unidentified individual (Fennesa)|individual]] hid in the hills on Fennesa. A group of individuals tracking the fugitive in the mountains then had to deal with the local nerfs interfering with their search.

==Description==
Fennesa was a rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Wizards" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Fennesa system/Legends|Fennesa system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its terrain included [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], hills,<ref name="Wizards" /> and rocky outcroppings.<ref name="NEGAS" /> The Fennesa mountains often featured rocky overhangs and shallow [[Cave/Legends|caves]].<ref name="Wizards" /> [[Grass/Legends|Grass]] and [[thistled scrub]]s grew between rocks, while the planet's fauna included both [[Unidentified avian species (Fennesa)|avian]] and [[Unidentified feline species (Fennesa)|feline]] [[Diet/Legends|predators]] as well as scavengers.<ref name="Wizards" />

When Fennesa was settled by [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], they brought along [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]],<ref name="CSWE Nerf">{{CSWECite|I|263|Fennesa mountain nerf}}</ref> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]], herbivorous herd [[ungulate]]s [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="NEGAS" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]],<ref name="Wizards" /> the creatures evolved into a distinct [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] known as [[mountain nerf]]s.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
{{RPGseed}}
At some point, a group of individuals were pursuing another [[Unidentified individual (Fennesa)|individual]]. The latter hid himself in the hills of Fennesa and allowed the local mountain nerfs to mark him with their spittle, thus making him more difficult to track by scent. While the individual's pursuers were traversing the planet's mountainous terrain in search of their quarry, they had several encounters with nerfs. The creatures rushed and spat upon the group and caused a rockslide by fleeing.<ref name="Wizards" />

The pursuers also had to deal with nerfs as they began to investigate the local caves. The nerfs hiding there interfered with the search efforts of the group, and its quarry was alerted to the pursuers' presence by the braying and spitting of the nerfs. The pursued individual then used the nerfs as a distraction and surprised his would-be captors.<ref name="Wizards" />
{{Endgame}}

At some point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], Fennesa was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was based on the research notes of [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Nerf-aa.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The inhabitants of Fennesa kept herds of mountain nerfs, a local subspecies of nerf (pictured).]]
Fennesa was settled by colonists several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CSWE Nerf" /> The inhabitants of Fennesa [[Nerf herder/Legends|kept]] herds of mountain nerfs, which were valued across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] for their [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]], [[Hair/Legends|fur]], and hides.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Nerfs on Fennesa were kept out on the mountains nearly year-long, and the [[Farmer/Legends|herding]] on the planet was overseen by the [[Fennesa Nerf Herding Council]].<ref name="Wizards" />

The nerf herders of Fennesa were a hardy people due to the challenges posed by their line of work. The herds had to be constantly protected from predators, and the unruly herbivores themselves kicked and spat upon their keepers. When the [[Time/Legends|time]] came for shearing or [[Death/Legends|slaughter]], the herders often had to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] down their nerfs one by one in the caves of the planet's mountains and drag them out of hiding. In addition,<ref name="Wizards" /> years of working with the foul-odored creatures often caused the herders to lose their sense of smell.<ref name="NEGAS" />

Despite the difficulties of their profession and the lack of respect by the wider galaxy, nerf herders had a sense of pride<ref name="NEGAS" /> in their own professionalism,<ref name="Wizards" /> and their trade often ran across generations,<ref name="NEGAS" /> as exemplified by the third-generation [[Human/Legends|Human]] herder [[Vreet Harak]].<ref name="Wizards" />

==Locations==
The family [[Farm/Legends|ranch]] known as the [[Grand Horn Ranch Corporation]] was located on Fennesa,<ref name="CSWE Harak" /> as were barns used by the nerf herders for shearing and health inspections.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fennesa was created for the article "[[Mountain Nerf]]," written by [[Jeff Quick]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[February 6]], [[2003]]. The article includes several adventure seeds for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', and this article assumes the scenarios play out as described.<ref name="Wizards" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Fennesa [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Fennesa itself, in grid square K-14.<ref name="TEA" />
